pages.text: $(l)Terralith$() adds 95+ biomes using vanilla blocks. $(l)Tectonic$() reshapes the terrain: real mountain ranges, deep valleys, and continents.$(br2)$(l)Distant Horizons$() renders low-detail terrain way past your normal view distance, so you can actually see those mountains.

Structures you'll run into:$(li)$(l)YUNG's$(): overhauled dungeons, mineshafts, strongholds, temples, fortresses, monuments$(li)$(l)Dungeons & Taverns$(): taverns, wizard towers, illager camps$(li)$(l)Towns & Towers$(): more village styles and pillager outposts$(br)Find a snowy biome for the $(o)Winter Break$() advancement.
